- linux/amd64

- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
This package provides optimization functionality for the wind farm and wake
modelling package foxes. It is based on the optimization interface package
iwopy, and enables the user to run fast vectorized and flexible optimizations
of wind farm layouts, wind farm control parameters, or any other set of
related model parameters.

name: foxes-opt
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "foxes-opt" %}
{% set version = "0.9.2" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/FraunhoferIWES/foxes-opt/archive/v{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 23e7c6b50cd2b700c32aa33fd348b79b2d2c4c7ab9adbc1e3fe1e2d01cd757fb

build:
  noarch: python
  script: {{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0
  entry_points:
    - foxes_opt_yaml = foxes_opt.input.yaml.yaml:foxes_opt_yaml

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
    - setuptools >=84.0.0
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - foxes >=1.9.8
    - iwopy >=1.0.0
    - pymoo >=0.6
    - xarray >=2023.9
    - netcdf4 >=1.7
    - pygmo >=2.19

test:
  imports:
    - foxes_opt
    - pygmo
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pytest >=9.0.3
  source_files:
    - tests
    - examples
    - notebooks
  commands:
    - pytest tests
    - foxes_opt_yaml --help

about:
  home: https://github.com/FraunhoferIWES/foxes-opt
  summary: Wind farm optimization functionality for foxes
  description: |
    This package provides optimization functionality for the wind farm and wake
    modelling package foxes. It is based on the optimization interface package
    iwopy, and enables the user to run fast vectorized and flexible optimizations
    of wind farm layouts, wind farm control parameters, or any other set of
    related model parameters.
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  doc_url: https://fraunhoferiwes.github.io/foxes-opt/index.html
  dev_url: https://github.com/FraunhoferIWES/foxes-opt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - SchmJo
